location: The reward section of [[Devovorga]]'s lair and several areas of the [[Cults of Tibia Quest]].
name: Gate of Deathstruction
notes:
In Devovorga's reward room, its purpose is to keep out levels lower than the threshold. The first set is meant to keep out everyone below level 40, whereas the second also prohibits all people between 40-70 from passing it.
On other places it works like a [[Magic Forcefield]] and [[teleport]]s the player between different areas.
